snippet.title: The Only Droid - Official Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam✨: (link in bio as well)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4393370/The_Only_Droid/

This is the progress of my game, The Only Droid! I've spent 6-7 months developing it so far, and it has gone from a barely functional prototype with a single robot and level-based gameplay to a full-on physics-based action roguelite. My game is a mix of fast-paced combat, deep build customization, and satisfying destruction. It's actually inspired by Megabonk, Risk of Rain 2, and Robots Forever, and I'm making it in the Unity game engine.
